description: MUTATES Parabol data: update an existing task. Required: id. Optionally change content (stringified TipTap JSON), status, assignee (userId), or sortOrder. Only included fields change. Parabol GraphQL: updateTask(updatedTask, area). Requires TASKS_WRITE.

content.description: New rich-text content as a stringified TipTap/ProseMirror JSON document.

fields.description: Additional documented GraphQL input fields to send verbatim in this mutation's input (merged OVER the typed fields above).

userId.description: Reassign the task to this user id.

name: update_task
title: Update a task
